chunks: And he said in another report:
He should not depart early by more than three days.

key_terms.لَا يَتَعَجَّلُ: he should not hasten or depart early

ai.seo_question: How many days in advance is one allowed to depart early for Mina according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal limitation regarding departing early, stating that it should not be done more than three days in advance. In the context of hajj rites and travel to Mina, it indicates a regulated timeframe rather than unrestricted advance departure.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2975 - In another narration, Imam (as) said:
"A person should not leave earlier than three days in advance."
